finalists.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
finalists.why: It has the most specific evidence, including nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma, and strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45.

finalists.label: Soft tissue sarcoma
finalists.why: It is supported by general findings such as an irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, tender mass and nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific evidence, including strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45, which are not shared with the runner-up.
